description: Number theory based HCF/LCM problems — divisibility, remainder tricks, applications

questions.stem: The HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24 and 36 is:
questions.explanation: Prime factorise: 24 = 2³ × 3, 36 = 2² × 3². HCF = product of LOWEST powers of common primes = 2² × 3¹ = 12. LCM = product of HIGHEST powers = 2³ × 3² = 72. Check: HCF × LCM = 12 × 72 = 864 = 24 × 36 ✓ (always holds for two numbers). Quick verification: 24 = 12 × 2, 36 = 12 × 3 — both divisible by 12 with no common factor in the quotients (2 and 3 are coprime).

questions.explanation: Prime factorise: 12 = 2² × 3, 15 = 3 × 5, 20 = 2² × 5. LCM = highest power of each prime = 2² × 3 × 5 = 60. Verify: 60/12 = 5 ✓, 60/15 = 4 ✓, 60/20 = 3 ✓ — divisible by all three with quotients (5, 4, 3) sharing no common factor → 60 is the SMALLEST such number.

questions.stem: What is the smallest number that, when divided by 12, 16, and 20, leaves a remainder of 4 in each case?
questions.explanation: When the same remainder is left, required number = LCM(divisors) + remainder. LCM(12, 16, 20). Factorise: 12 = 2²·3; 16 = 2⁴; 20 = 2²·5. LCM = 2⁴ · 3 · 5 = 240. Add remainder 4 → 244. Verify: 244/12 = 20 r 4 ✓; 244/16 = 15 r 4 ✓; 244/20 = 12 r 4 ✓.

questions.stem: Three bells ring at intervals of 9, 12 and 15 minutes. They ring together at 9:00 a.m. After how long do they ring together again?
questions.explanation: Bells ring together again after LCM of intervals. LCM(9, 12, 15). 9 = 3², 12 = 2²·3, 15 = 3·5. LCM = 2² · 3² · 5 = 180 minutes = 3 hours. So next together at 12:00 noon.

questions.stem: The product of two numbers is 1,440 and their LCM is 240. The HCF is:
questions.explanation: For any two positive integers: HCF × LCM = product of the numbers. So 240 × HCF = 1440 → HCF = 1440/240 = 6. The two numbers could be (6, 240), (12, 120), (24, 60), (48, 30) — all pairs whose product is 1440 and HCF is 6 must satisfy LCM = 240. Verify with (24, 60): HCF(24, 60) = 12 (not 6) — so this pair fails; only (30, 48) and similar pairs satisfy both conditions exactly.

questions.stem: Find the LCM of two numbers if their HCF is 5 and the numbers themselves are 25 and 30.
questions.explanation: HCF × LCM = product of the numbers. 5 × LCM = 25 × 30 = 750 → LCM = 150. Verify: 25 = 5² and 30 = 2·3·5. LCM = 2·3·5² = 150 ✓. Check HCF: only common prime power is 5¹ → HCF = 5 ✓.
